title: Tue 27 Oct 2026: Wall Street rebounds as oil eases, Budget and Fed day looms, SM&CR overhaul, active ETF launches
summary: Wall Street and Europe rally on Monday as Brent eases and the American ten year yield slips back below five percent. Tomorrow brings the Budget and the Fed decision, with the ECB and Bank of Japan to follow. In regulation, the FCA and PRA propose a major overhaul of the Senior Managers regime and the FCA flags weak conflicts controls in private markets; in funds, a wave of active ETFs and elevated private credit redemptions, plus three COO action points and the week's diary.
